description: It’s just life , take the risk. Jump #selflove #responsibility #risks
transcript: You're so risk adverse that you can't even enjoy life because you allow the external world to make decisions for you. Risks are meant to be taken. Of course, proceed with caution, but not everything is a life or death situation. Make a choice. Do it. Go after it. Don't one can manage your life for you. Take the risk. Do the thing.
